I told Dana in a thread on her #north-team message that the settled figure for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats.

Ilse first posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14. Later that day she corrected it in #north-random to 100, saying she had read the wrong line. Dana is in #north-random, so she could already see that correction.

My Oct 14 reply in #north-team ("noted: 261 seats") is still there and doesn't match the corrected figure. The new reply to Dana says to use 100, not 261, so anyone reading #north-team will see the correction.

There are no Quarrendon account files in the share I can access, so I had no contract or CRM record to check the figure against.
